notes.title: Donation Update
notes.notes:
A few players have asked if they could financially support me for creating [i]A Game About[/i]. It is now possible through the donation DLC! Note that DLC [b]does not[/b] add any content to the game and is only a mean to send me love in form of a little tip (I thought $2 is about fair).

I am currently working on new prototypes, both for free and paid games, and while I can't promise right now that any of them will become a full-fledged game, I will promise that any money I receive from tips will be used to buy myself coffees* while I work on those prototypes.

I'm still amazed that [i]A Game About[/i] managed to reach so many players. I still get a warm feeling in my heart reading the positive (and negative) words people wrote about it here on Steam and elsewhere on the internet. Just talking about the game already means a lot to me, so please don't feel obligated to buy the DLC if you don't want to or are low on money.

Thank you so much to you all. <3
Olivier

*I only drink decaffeinated coffee right now as my therapist says coffee makes my anxiety worse right now, can you imagine?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33732505/55117983d716f9d9b050fa784f7bbdd815c4a530.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch notes and Thank you
notes.notes:
Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would get stuck in a loop during "The Next Day" sequence.
[/list]

I also wanted to thank all the players and the Steam community. When I released my game, I did not expect it to get much attention, let alone get over two hundred reviews in less than a month.

I am sincerely humbled by the reaction to my small experimental project. It gives me hope to see that the game connects with people. I thank you all from the bottom of my heart.

Olivier
